title: Applying for Long-term Study Abroad

category.title: Who is elgible to apply for a student visa?
list_content: A person living outside the United States
A person planning to stay in America for over 90 days
A person attending a language school(Educational institution) in the U.S.

category.title: Application Steps
content: It usually takes about 3 monthsin order to obtain a student visa and study abroad. It is reommended to leave as much time as possible to complete the application process. Please apply at least three months in advance.If applying less than 3 months prior to departure, please inform our staff.

category.title: About the steps after application
content:
After students have applied, the iMLI system processes the application.
Students can follow the process which is listed on the iMLI.

category.title: Apply Online
content:
Fill out the information about your visa status
Contact us via iMLI for all inquiries
*Please have your credit card in hand.
